description: List the tours Follow On Tours currently has published, with destination, sport and dates. Use this to find out what is on sale before asking about a specific tour. Returns only published tours — the same set a visitor can see on the website — in `tours`. Tours that are announced but NOT yet on sale come back separately in `holdingTours`: they cannot be booked and their schedules are not confirmed, so never present one as bookable. A coming-soon tour may carry `details` — the full public text of its page (intro, sections, FAQs) — which is safe to quote. For the golf trips use list_golf_trips.
name: list_tours
